sam: FYI onboarding pegasus7b-lite (int4 path). Long-context summarization diverges from fp16 after ~240 tokens. Quick smoke shows outputs drift and some odd logits on punctuation/soft-hyphen tokens. Repro below.

sam: Repro (local):
```
# convert -> quant -> smoke
python tools/convert_model.py --src models/pegasus7b/fp16 --out /tmp/pegasus7b/int4 --converter gemma-converter@3f9b2c1 \
  && python tools/quantize.py --model /tmp/pegasus7b/int4 --config int4-default.yaml \
  && pytest -q tests/smoke/test_long_summarize.py::test_long_summarize --model /tmp/pegasus7b/int4
```

sam: Log excerpt: 
```
[2024-06-06 09:08:12] WARN rotary_table_mismatch head=12 expected=1.0000 got=0.9958
[2024-06-06 09:08:12] ERROR vocab_map_collision: ids 31245==31246 (0x00AD soft-hyphen)
[2024-06-06 09:08:12] INFO divergence_token="." index=241
```

nina: Which tokenizer and vocab did you use? pegasus-native vs shared-qwen? Also paste model hash and converter commit.

sam: tokenizer=pegasus-native v1.3, model_hash=sha256:deadbeef..., converter=gemma-converter@3f9b2c1. Tried shared-qwen briefly; collision pattern slightly different.

lee: Two suspects: 1) token id aliasing (soft-hyphens / zwj variants), 2) rotary phase table per-head normalization differences after conversion. Can you run vocab-diff and a headwise rotary dump?

sam: Running vocab-diff: `python tools/vocab_diff.py --base pegasus-native.json --other /tmp/pegasus7b/int4/vocab.json --report /tmp/vocab-diff.csv`

sam: Short vocab-diff output: `checked 50290 tokens, collisions=5, examples: 0x00AD -> ids 31245/31246; 0x200C -> ids 4821/4822`

sam: Headwise rotary stats: mean_phase_delta=0.0012 stdev=0.0019, head_sign_flips=0 (64 heads)

raj: Small phase delta + a handful of aliased tokens can amplify over long generation. Also check KV-cache indexing and whether converter shifted eos/bos ids (off-by-one bug we saw before). Dump a logit delta at token ~240 with `--logit-diff` between fp16 and int4.

sam: Ran with `--logit-diff` on a failing sample: `L2=0.37, max=4.2` at idx=241; delta concentrated on 3 tokens (soft-hyphen variants and quirky punctuation). Attached /artifacts/pegasus7b/1718409999/logit-diff.csv

ci-bot: CI job started: quant-smoke/pegasus7b/1718409999 -> https://ci.redwood/quant-smoke/1718409999 (job#7)

nina: Short-term mitigation: add an explicit token remap during conversion that preserves canonical pegasus token ids (fail conversion if collisions>0 by default). Also try `--rotary-canonical` in converter (forces canonical sin/cos tables and per-head normalization).

lee: Agreed. For diagnostics also run `python tools/inspect_kv_cache.py --model /tmp/pegasus7b/int4 --trace sample_trace.json` to ensure cached indices align.

sam: Tried `--preserve-ids` + `--rotary-canonical`. Smoke fuzzers passed locally; SummEval 1k job queued to check quality across prompts.

raj: If SummEval still shows drift at >512 tokens, we may need per-head zero-point re-calibration for quantized proj layers. Keep an eye on per-head logit norms.

sam: Opening onboarding ticket now with artifact links and patch suggestion. Ticket: https://issues.redwood/onboard/PEG-1123 assigned to @nina and @lee, label:onb/pegasus7b, prio=P2
